title: Jezreel's Tower

source: Kent Historic Environment Record point and contemporary published dimensional evidence

mappedIdentity.name: Jezreel's Tower
mappedIdentity.address: Former tower site, Chatham Hill, Gillingham, Medway, Kent, United Kingdom

features.role: Reconstructed 124-foot square at the county’s documented monument point.

identityStatus: The official Kent register locates the disused site. The registered 124 foot architectural dimension is used as the representative plan span. Original photography supplies the four identical elevations and the interior proportion controls.

terrainContact.basis: Environment Agency native ground near the former road-facing foundation on Chatham Hill. The original site level is estimated over the current field.

notes: Chatham Hill’s one-metre present-day terrain anchors the placement. The roofless shell follows the 1903 original images. The section follows the open rounded roof skeleton, encircling galleries, 12 major curved girders and the lower floor depression photographed in the original press.
